name: Briar Hound
codex: Feral border curs colonized by parasitic iron-bramble that grows directly through their ribs. They hunt in starving packs along the Sunken Ford; cut them down with fire or wide-sweeping blades before they surround isolated archers.

special.name: Bramble Pounce
special.desc: Leaps 4 tiles to bite for 10 damage and inflicts 2 bleed/s for 4 s.
special.telegraph: Lowers its snout to the dirt as the wooden spine-thorns rattle violently.

loot_theme: Light hides, thorny kindling, and copper coins swallowed from dead scouts.

name: Flintback
codex: Lumbering quarry-beasts whose dorsal hides have calcified into overlapping slabs of grey chert. Arrows and light swords glance harmlessly off their posture; soften them with crushing maces or lightning magic.

special.name: Shoulder Crag Slam
special.desc: Charges 3 tiles and bashes for 15 physical damage, stunning for 2 s.
special.telegraph: Drags its knuckles in the gravel and tilts its tall left shoulder-stone forward.

loot_theme: Heavy shields, iron ore fragments, and dented warrior helms.

name: Mire Wisp
codex: Pockets of marsh methane and spiteful lingering memory anchored inside drowned livestock skulls. Keep your formation spread out so their corpse-gas volleys cannot rot the entire vanguard at once.

special.name: Drowned Lantern Flare
special.desc: Spits a glob of marsh-gas (radius 2) dealing 11 poison damage and reducing accuracy by 3 for 6 s.
special.telegraph: The rusted left-side lantern swings wildly and flares toxic emerald.

loot_theme: Mana draughts, apprentice wands, and tarnished brass charms.

name: Ruin Mite
codex: Blind, sandstone-chewing arthropods that nest in the foundations of abandoned watchtowers. Individually trivial, their serrated mandibles can saw through greaves if allowed to swarm a stationary tank.

special.name: Saw-Mandible Clamp
special.desc: Snaps for 8 damage and reduces target's armor by 2 for 6 s.
special.telegraph: Rears back on its hind legs and opens its oversized right mandible wide.

loot_theme: Low-tier boots, chipped flint daggers, and small healing draughts.

name: Thorn Boar
codex: Ill-tempered greywood swine grown massive on a diet of unburied border skirmishers and witch-hazel roots. Sidestep their straight-line gore attacks and strike their unarmored flanks.

special.name: Root-Tusk Gore
special.desc: Rushes 5 tiles in a line, dealing 14 damage and knocking targets back 2 tiles.
special.telegraph: Paws the mud twice and drops its giant branched left tusk to knee-height.

loot_theme: Padded jerkins, axes, and hearty stamina-restoring rations.

name: Quill Fiend
codex: Hunched, sinewy scavengers that fire calcified ribs through a hollow bone trough fused to their right forearm. Close the distance immediately with fast cavalry or hasted infantry before they pin your casters.

special.name: Bone-Volley Fan
special.desc: Fires 3 bone needles in a narrow cone for 8 piercing damage each.
special.telegraph: Arches its spine forward until the dorsal fan of bone quills clicks upright.

loot_theme: Shortbows, arrows, light gloves, and bone rings.

name: Cinder Shaman
codex: Hedge-priests of the ash-cults who carry burning bone-totems strapped to their spines. Always kill the Shaman first; if left chanting in the rear, he will endlessly re-ignite fallen hounds and raiders.

special.name: Ashen Revival
special.desc: Restores a fallen non-boss enemy within 5 tiles to 50% HP with a fiery aura.
special.telegraph: Raises his charred right-hand staff high as the skull-totem on his back belches orange flame.

loot_theme: Spell scrolls, mage staves, ember charms, and mana potions.

name: Glasswing
codex: High-altitude predators with four razor-edged wings of translucent silica. They hover over impassable terrain to pelt troops with obsidian tail-shards; bring them down with accurate bowfire or instant lightning spells.

special.name: Obsidian Stinger Dart
special.desc: Fires a glass shard from 6 tiles away for 12 damage that inflicts 3 bleed/s for 4 s.
special.telegraph: Whip-curls its double obsidian tail-stinger over its head while hovering stationary.

loot_theme: Quartz focuses, swift boots, and high-accuracy daggers.

name: Rootbound
codex: Ancient boundary cairns overgrown by strangler-oaks that absorbed the frontier's spilled blood. Extremely slow but capable of flattening a shield-wall in two swings; kite them across open ground with fire magic.

special.name: Monolith Root-Slam
special.desc: Smashes a 2-tile area in front for 18 earth damage and roots targets for 3 s.
special.telegraph: Slowly hoists its colossal right root-hammer overhead while the left shoulder-stone glows lime-green.

loot_theme: Oak staves, heavy shields, stone charms, and earth scrolls.

name: Cinderling
codex: Malformed volcanic homunculi with smoking chimney-skulls and a dragging left arm of molten slag. They scurry around the edges of battle hurling magma globs; a single Frost Bolt will crack their brittle crust.

special.name: Slag Lob
special.desc: Flings molten rock at a 1.5-radius spot (range 6) for 11 fire damage, leaving burning ground for 4 s.
special.telegraph: Spins in a tight circle, scooping glowing magma with its long left arm.

aggro: Hot! Hot for the tall ones!

loot_theme: Fire scrolls, ember charms, and small piles of fused gold.

name: Gloom Stag
codex: Gaunt, long-legged cervids of the deep Greywood whose deadwood antlers trail ribbons of narcotic shadow-mist. They ignore the frontline to gore back-row mages; keep a reserve pikeman or Stone Curse ready.

special.name: Shadow-Antler Rush
special.desc: Blinks through mist for 4 tiles and gores for 15 astral/physical damage, silencing for 3 s.
special.telegraph: The skull tangled in its wide left antler flares violet as the stag lowers its rack.

loot_theme: Stalker hoods, bows, agility rings, and astral charms.

name: Salt Crab
codex: Tidal crustaceans that build towering shells from brine-crystals and wrecked Oakhaven hull planks. Frontal physical attacks bounce off their massive left shield-claw; flank them or boil them inside their shells with lightning.

special.name: Brine-Shield Guard
special.desc: Raises its left claw for 4 s, reducing frontal damage by 70% before lunging for 13 damage.
special.telegraph: Slams its flat salt-crystal left claw into the mud like a pavise shield.

loot_theme: Heavy armor, bucklers, and salt-preserved rations.

name: Bog Dartblower
codex: Diminutive swamp-dwellers concealed behind ritual masks twice their own height. They kite relentlessly through the reeds while spitting neurotoxic needles; use area-of-effect Fireballs or fast archers to sweep them clear.

special.name: Paralyzing Reed-Dart
special.desc: Shoots a toxic dart (range 7) for 7 damage that slows by 40% and poisons (2/s) for 6 s.
special.telegraph: Hops backward on one foot and steadies the long bamboo pipe with both hands.

loot_theme: Stilettos, poison scrolls, light boots, and wooden charms.

name: Witch Doctor
codex: Tribal elders of the Redmarsh fringes draped in crocodile jaws and bubbling alembic flasks. Their hexes rot armor and turn healing potions sour; interrupt their censer-swings or silence them from afar.

special.name: Mire-Marrow Hex
special.desc: Curses a 2.5-radius area, reducing armor by 3 and dealing 9 poison damage over 8 s.
special.telegraph: Swings the smoking left-hand skull censer in a wide violet circle overhead.

aggro: The marsh wants its iron back!

loot_theme: Potions, elixirs, hexing wands, and scholar hats.

name: Hollow Knight
codex: Suits of imperial border-plate animated by the muscle-memory of soldiers who refused to yield their posts. Though missing their left arms, they drag greatswords that cleave through two ranks at once; melt their joints with fire or acid.

special.name: One-Armed Execution Sweep
special.desc: Cleaves a 180-degree frontal arc for 17 physical damage, ignoring 3 armor.
special.telegraph: Drags the greatsword behind its right heel, drawing a shower of blue sparks on the stone.

loot_theme: Knight swords, plate armor, steel helms, and gauntlets.

name: Spore Matron
codex: Bloated fungal colonies shaped vaguely like bent washerwomen, carrying umbrella-caps dripping with yellow mycotoxins. Never fight them in narrow corridors; burn them from maximum bow-range before their right-side sacs rupture.

special.name: Mycotoxin Vent
special.desc: Releases a 3-radius spore cloud around itself dealing 4 poison/s for 8 s and slowing by 25%.
special.telegraph: The three glowing tumors on its right flank swell to bursting and pulse bright lime.

loot_theme: Earth scrolls, mage robes, and alchemical draughts.

name: Dune Lurker
codex: Ochre-shelled desert mantids that lie buried up to their eyes in the dry creek beds of Bracken Basin. They erupt beneath stragglers with cross-scythe slashes; keep Stone Skin on your rear guard when crossing sand.

special.name: Sand-Trap Ambush
special.desc: Burrows and erupts behind the lowest-armor target within 5 tiles for 16 slashing damage.
special.telegraph: Crosses its oversized serrated right scythe over its chest and sinks into the sand.

loot_theme: Poignards, studded leather, and agility gear.

name: Storm Kite
codex: Leathery sky-rays that ride the thermal updrafts of the Redmarsh escarpments, storing static charge in their bronze-veined left wingtips. Ground them quickly or equip Storm Charms before they link lightning across your squad.

special.name: Wingtip Arc-Discharge
special.desc: Fires a lightning bolt (range 8) for 14 air damage that jumps to 2 nearby allies for 8 damage.
special.telegraph: Banks vertically in mid-air as blue sparks bridge its horns and forked tail.

loot_theme: Storm charms, air scrolls, and composite bows.

name: Basalt Brute
codex: Walking siege-engines of hexagonal black rock animated by the caldera's deep pressure. Their battering-ram right arms can shatter a shield-wall in one blow; immobilize their wide feet with ice magic and chip them down from range.

special.name: Tectonic Ram
special.desc: Slams its right arm into the earth, dealing 22 damage in a 4-tile line and knocking down for 2.5 s.
special.telegraph: Magma flares brightly between the hexagonal pillars on its back as it drags its ram-arm back.

loot_theme: Warhammers, greatmauls, tower shields, and plate mail.

name: Sand Raider
codex: Salt-bitten desert cutthroats wearing scarab-shell pauldrons and wielding twin curved scimitars. They sprint past slow heavy infantry to butcher archers; catch them with Haste or snare them in narrow choke points.

special.name: Dune-Dervishes' Cross-Cut
special.desc: Dashes 4 tiles and strikes twice for 9 damage each, inflicting bleed.
special.telegraph: Drops into a low sprinter's crouch and scrapes both scimitar blades together.

loot_theme: Curved blades, leather boots, gold pouches, and water draughts.

name: Dune Scarab
codex: Carapace-plated beetles with forked copper horns that act as living Leyden jars. Striking their cracked right shell with metal weapons triggers a static backfire; engage them with ranged magic or wooden staves.

special.name: Ball-Lightning Horn
special.desc: Launches a slow lightning orb (range 7) that explodes for 15 air damage in a 2-tile radius.
special.telegraph: A blinding cyan arc forms between the tips of its forked copper horn.

loot_theme: Rings, amulets, lightning scrolls, and copper bands.

name: Scale Viper
codex: Armored desert serpents that rear up on clawed forelimbs and sweep with a halberd-like bone blade at the tip of their tails. Their venom blinds and weakens; keep antidotes or Blessing active on your point man.

special.name: Halberd-Tail Whip
special.desc: Lunges 3 tiles and whips its tail for 14 damage plus 3 poison/s for 6 s.
special.telegraph: Coils high on its tail, flaring its spiked cobra hood wide as the tail-blade glints.

loot_theme: Scale armor, poison charms, and agile weapons.

name: Dune Beast
codex: Sail-backed oasis predators whose crocodile jaws occupy nearly half their body length. They leap over frontline shields to snap at wounded soldiers; focus fire on them the moment their dorsal fin breaks the scrub.

special.name: Oasis-Clearing Leap
special.desc: Jumps 5 tiles over obstacles to bite for 16 physical damage, pinning the target for 2 s.
special.telegraph: Flattens its tall dorsal sail and flares the three bone gill-spikes on its left neck.

loot_theme: Heavy hides, brigandines, and body-enhancing gear.

name: Maggot Swarm
codex: A churning carpet of pale carrion-larvae piloting a half-digested ribcage through the alkaline mud. Single-target arrows and swords are wasted on the mass; incinerate the entire cluster with Fireball or Flame Burst.

special.name: Acid-Bile Surge
special.desc: Spits digestive slime in a 2-tile cone for 10 acid damage, corroding armor by 3 for 8 s.
special.telegraph: The giant red-jawed alpha larva rears high out of the right side of the ribcage.

loot_theme: Bone rings, acid scrolls, and half-digested jewelry.

name: Lantern Eel
codex: Amphibious bog-serpents that slither onto the flooded causeways of the Iron Coast at high tide. Their angler-lures discharge lethal arcs through standing water; lure them onto dry paving stones before engaging.

special.name: Tidal Arc-Lure
special.desc: Shocks the target and any unit standing in water within 3 tiles for 15 lightning damage.
special.telegraph: Whips its overhead bioluminescent lure forward as its serrated right fin fans out.

loot_theme: Mana potions, astral spheres, and lightning-resistant gear.

name: Ash Weaver
codex: Four-armed cinder-cultists who spin incandescent filaments of glass and soot above their cowls. Their fire-webs entangle and immolate entire squads; snipe them early or use Wind Ward to deflect their casts.

special.name: Cinder-Silk Net
special.desc: Throws a burning web (radius 2.5) that roots foes for 3 s and deals 5 fire damage/s.
special.telegraph: All four spider-like arms cross overhead, pulling a bright orange net from its smoking left mantle.

loot_theme: Silk gloves, velvet mantles, fire tomes, and wands.

name: Pale Burrower
codex: Eyeless subterranean hulks from the Deep Quarry whose hands have ossified into broad bone shovels. They tunnel beneath shield-walls to toss infantry into the air; watch the dirt ripples and stun them as they surface.

special.name: Upheaval Scoop
special.desc: Emerges from underground, flinging targets in a 2-tile radius upward for 16 damage and 2 s stun.
special.telegraph: The rusted pickaxe stuck in its back vibrates and clanks against its chain before it digs.

loot_theme: Heavy axes, iron boots, and raw quarry gemstones.

name: Ironbark
codex: Centuries-old coastal ward-trees whose sap has been replaced by bog-iron and whose left trunks are armored with ancient bronze shields. Conventional arrows cannot pierce them; use armor-shredding mauls or intense fire.

special.name: Fortress-Bough Sweep
special.desc: Sweeps both knee-length branch arms for 20 physical damage and pushes foes back 3 tiles.
special.telegraph: The emerald hollow in its chest flares brightly as the bronze shields on its left side clang together.

loot_theme: Tower shields, thorn staves, and high-tier defensive charms.

name: Rift Moth
codex: Silent nocturnal lepidopterans from the high passes whose wing-patterns resemble staring astral eyes. Their gaze drains mana directly from casters' minds; have your archers shoot them down before your mages run dry.

special.name: Void-Eye Siphon
special.desc: Beams astral light at a target (range 7), draining 18 mana and dealing 14 astral damage.
special.telegraph: Spreads its wings flat, causing the violet astral tear on its lower right wing to blaze.

loot_theme: Astral wands, mana potions, sage cowls, and mind rings.

name: Crypt Embalmer
codex: High mortuary priests of the Redmarsh dynasties whose hollowed left ribs house nests of venomous copperheads. They raise fallen skeletons and suffocate the living in bitumen fumes; cleanse them from afar with fire.

special.name: Canopic Serpent Breath
special.desc: Exhales necrotic mist and snakes in a 3-tile cone for 16 poison damage, preventing healing for 6 s.
special.telegraph: Pulls open its bandaged left ribcage as green smoke pours from beneath its golden crown.

loot_theme: Ancient gold rings, tomes of resurrection, and ornate staves.

name: Hollow King
codex: Fallen petty-monarchs of the coastal keeps whose iron crowns were hammered directly into their skulls. Impervious to fear and cold, their royal maces shatter bone; kite them with Haste and melt their plate with fire.

special.name: Sovereign Decree Smash
special.desc: Crushes the ground (radius 2.5) for 22 physical/cold damage and slows movement by 50% for 5 s.
special.telegraph: Raises his royal mace with both hands as the three impaled swords in his left shoulder glow cyan.

loot_theme: Executioner blades, gothic plate, dread helms, and royal signets.

name: Frosthorn Bruiser
codex: Hulking alpine beasts from the peaks above Oakhaven with a solid gauntlet of blue glacier-ice encasing their left arms. Every blow chills the blood; keep Ember or Frost Charms equipped and burn through their thick white pelts.

special.name: Glacier-Fist Haymaker
special.desc: Swings its ice-encased left arm for 20 cold/physical damage, freezing the target solid for 2.5 s.
special.telegraph: Scrapes its forward-curving ice horns on the ground and drags its giant blue left fist back.

loot_theme: Frost charms, heavy axes, furs, and giant gauntlets.

name: Crowned Maw
codex: Apex pack-leaders of the volcanic foothills bearing a jagged collar of bone horns behind their half-flayed skulls. They smell wounded soldiers across the map and sprint to finish them; guard your injured behind Stone Skin.

special.name: Blood-Scent Lunge
special.desc: Leaps 6 tiles to an injured target, dealing 19 damage (28 if target is below 50% HP).
special.telegraph: Flares its neck-crown of bone horns wide while crimson saliva drips from its flayed right jaw.

loot_theme: High-tier daggers, shadow masks, and lifesteal rings.

name: Frost Bell
codex: Haunted liturgical bronze bells torn from drowned coastal chapels, levitating on chains of rime. When their skull-clappers strike, the sound freezes mana and muscle alike; shatter their cracked right flanks with heavy maces.

special.name: Vesper Toll of Rime
special.desc: Rings a 4-radius sonic wave dealing 15 cold damage and adding 15 to all spell cooldowns.
special.telegraph: Tilts sharply backward as the glowing frost-skull clapper swings out through the right-side crack.

loot_theme: Spell-mirrors, astral medallions, and water tomes.

name: Silt Colossus
codex: Towering citadel guardians formed from compressed river-silt and the masonry of ruined watchtowers. Physical blades sink uselessly into their mud-and-stone bulk; crack them open with Quake or concentrated Lightning.

special.name: Temple-Pillar Sweep
special.desc: Swings its broken stone column in a wide arc for 25 physical damage, knocking back 3 tiles.
special.telegraph: Sand pours in a waterfall from its right shoulder as it lifts the left-hand temple pillar.

loot_theme: Aegis shields, colossus amulets, and high-tier earth tomes.

name: Redglass Drake
codex: Lesser volcanic dragons of the Act IV ridges whose wing-membranes are sheets of razor-sharp red obsidian. Stay out of their frontal cone when their throats glow orange, and ground them with cold magic.

special.name: Vitreous Flame-Breath
special.desc: Breathes liquid fire in a 5-tile cone for 22 fire damage, leaving molten glass that slows for 5 s.
special.telegraph: Rears on its hind legs, flaring its red-glass wings as magma rises up its throat.

loot_theme: Wyrmscale cuirasses, dragon leather mantles, and meteor tomes.

name: Night Orchard
codex: Gnarled black gallows-trees animated by the shadow covens, bearing glowing magenta skulls like ripe plums. They hurl screaming skull-fruit into your backline; chop them down with fire-enchanted axes.

special.name: Harvest of Skulls
special.desc: Lobs 3 glowing skull-fruits at ranged targets for 14 astral damage each, inflicting Weaken.
special.telegraph: The heavy right-side canopy shakes violently as the hanging magenta skulls shriek in unison.

loot_theme: Astral staves, archon wands, and dark velvet robes.

name: Stormtree
codex: Colossal highland pines split down the center by perpetual lightning, holding a crackling plasma core between their halves. Never clump melee troops around their grounding chains; use earth shields and ranged fire.

special.name: Grounding-Chain Surge
special.desc: Slams its branches, discharging 24 lightning damage in a 3.5-radius ring around its roots.
special.telegraph: The plasma orb in its split crown drops downward as the heavy left iron chain glows white-hot.

loot_theme: Thunderstorm tomes, greatbows, and high-tier lightning charms.

name: Dread Knight
codex: Elite vanguard champions of the Infernal Citadel clad in meteoric black iron and skull-faced pauldrons. Their two-handed battleaxes cleave through shields; slow them with Blizzard and focus them down with astral magic.

special.name: Hell-Vanguard Cleave
special.desc: Swings its greataxe for 22 physical/fire damage and ignites the ground for 5 fire/s over 5 s.
special.telegraph: The fiery runes on its right pauldron flare crimson as it steps forward with a two-handed grip.

hit: Scratch the iron, bleed the man!

loot_theme: Zweihanders, decapitator axes, full plate, and champion rings.

name: Cinderhorn
codex: Towering furnace-chested megademons of the caldera floor, swinging chained cast-iron weights from their right arms. Stay clear of their mid-range flail sweeps and douse their open ribcage fires with Ice Storm or Blizzard.

special.name: Furnace-Rib Breath
special.desc: Exhales a wide 4-tile cone of hellfire from its chest for 25 fire damage, melting 4 armor.
special.telegraph: Beats its chained iron weight against its hooves as the open furnace in its chest roars white.

loot_theme: Endgame weapons, fire-resistant greaves, and demon-forged charms.

name: Anvilmaw Smith
codex: Living siege-titans of the Cinderforge with iron anvils for lower jaws and smoking chimneys protruding from their spines. When they strike their own jaws with their hammer-arms, scatter immediately to avoid the shrapnel.

special.name: Anvil-Jaw Shrapnel Strike
special.desc: Hammers its own jaw, spraying molten sparks in a 3.5-radius for 20 fire/physical damage and stunning 1.5 s.
special.telegraph: Clamps its left-arm tongs shut and raises its colossal right-arm smithing hammer toward its chin.

loot_theme: Titan gauntlets, obsidian mauls, gothic plate, and tier-5 gear.

name: Morvessa, the Silk Widow
codex: BOSS (Act I). An ancient arachnid matriarch nesting in the Weeping Ossuary beneath Ravenwatch, crowned with a cathedral spire of woven bone and silk. Destroy her brood-cocoons before they hatch and keep poison resistance high during her Venom Spray.

special.name: Ossuary Brood-Lash
special.desc: Lashed in a 4-tile arc for 24 poison/physical damage, knocking down for 2 s and hatching 2 spiderlings.
special.telegraph: Rears up on all eight legs as the glowing victim-cocoon on her left abdomen pulses violet.

aggro: Come into the parlor, little iron flies...
Your marrow will feed the third clutch!

loot_theme: Act I Unique items, rare staves, and enchanted silks.

name: Gorrathul, the Sand Glutton
codex: BOSS (Act II). A four-armed desert abomination crowned with golden obelisks, possessing a second vertical maw down its belly that radiates an unnatural heat-sink chill. Avoid standing directly in front of its belly-maw and scatter when it burrows.

special.name: Gullet of the Dunes
special.desc: Burrows and erupts beneath the party for 32 damage, pulling units inward toward its freezing belly-maw.
special.telegraph: The vertical maw on its stomach yawns wide as all four arms—including the giant right scorpion pincer—dig in.

aggro: CARAVANS... CITIES... ALL GRAIN FOR THE MILL!
hit: A SHARP BONE IN THE MEAT!

loot_theme: Act II Unique items, ancient desert gold, and high-tier charms.

name: Vesperion, the Hollow Choir
codex: BOSS (Act III). A six-winged spectral arch-prelate hovering above the flooded nave, bearing a towering pipe-organ of human femurs above its cowl. Interrupt its liturgical crescendos and spread out to avoid bouncing Ball Lightning and Frost Novas.

special.name: Antiphon of the Drowned
special.desc: Chords the bone-organ, draining 25 mana and dealing 28 lightning/cold damage in a 4.5-radius ring.
special.telegraph: Four main arms rise like a conductor's while spectral hands swing censers from its open right robe.

aggro: Take your seats in the flooded pews...
Sing with the water in your lungs!

loot_theme: Act III Unique items, archmage regalia, and high-tier spell tomes.

name: Ashkarath, the Cinder King
codex: BOSS (Act IV). The three-meter sovereign of the Obsidian Throne, crowned with a blazing halo of fused iron swords and wielding four arms. Break his Bone Prisons immediately so your squad is not trapped inside his Hellfire Breath and Red Lightning rings.

special.name: Decree of Crown and Ember
special.desc: Cages the furthest target in bone, then sweeps a 6-tile molten greatsword arc for 38 fire/astral damage.
special.telegraph: The living dragon-skull on his left shoulder belches black smoke as the sword-halo above his head blazes white.

aggro: Kneel in the cinders of your history!
Order is a lie told by cold ashes!
hit: You strike the mountain with a needle!
death: The ember... only waits... for wind...

loot_theme: Act IV Unique items, sovereign artifacts, and tier-5 masterworks.
